raw_answer_text:
Looking at the error messages, I can identify two issues:

1. **`"block" is not allowed in genre block`** — In the `block` genre, you don't use the `block` keyword to declare nodes. Just declare the id and label directly.

2. **`edge needs an operator`** — Edges require a directional operator (`->`, `<-`, `--`, or `<->`), not just bare ids.

For a telemetry pipeline where data flows from source to destination, the `->` operator is appropriate.

Here's the corrected document:

```figdown
# FigDown — figures as text. Spec: https://github.com/FigDown/figdown
figdown 0.1 block
title "Telemetry export pipeline"

poller "Poller"
normalizer "Normalizer"
healthprobe "Health Probe"
buffer "Ring Buffer"
exporter "Exporter"

poller -> normalizer
healthprobe -> normalizer
normalizer -> buffer
buffer -> exporter
```

The changes:
- Removed the `block` keyword from each node declaration (lines 5–9)
- Added `->` directional operators to all edges (lines 11–14), showing data flowing left-to-right through the pipeline
- Kept all ids, labels, title, and connections as specified
